identities.title: Kimi Code CLI initial public repository family
identities.screening_reason: Full README reviewed: terminal code editing/shell/search/web, TUI, conversational MCP configuration, isolated coder/explore/plan subagents and lifecycle hooks package existing agent capabilities; no new mechanism, failure boundary, evaluation contract or evidence that changes an existing design choice.

identities.title: wire qwen2-family ViT to the multimodal metadata precompute hook
identities.screening_reason: GPU-forward D2H synchronization is replaced by an explicit host-collator metadata producer/device-consumer contract with a runtime fallback and bitwise-equivalence gate; this may change how a multimodal training runtime assigns layout computation and correctness checks.
identities.books_disposition: Integrate — root applied, fresh non-author review passed

identities.title: shorten loss-wrapper return to (loss, logits, fused_linear_aux)
identities.screening_reason: The PR moves already-defined #771 per-token outputs into one internal dataclass and shrinks a 7-tuple to a 3-tuple. It improves maintainability but adds no new distillation objective, numerical boundary, cross-runtime contract or result beyond the earlier-owner #771 mechanism.

identities.title: disable HSDP gradient all-reduce during gradient accumulation
identities.screening_reason: HSDP gradient synchronization has two ownership dimensions: sharded reduce-scatter is preserved while replicated all-reduce can be delayed until the final accumulation micro-step. This changes collective timing without changing memory and requires an explicit optimizer-step boundary.
identities.books_disposition: Integrate — root applied, fresh non-author review passed

identities.title: add Qwen-Image LoRA config
identities.screening_reason: The core explanation says only a LoRA configuration and docs are added, with no mechanism, comparative evaluation, failure condition or compatibility correction that changes LoRA/training-system design.

identities.title: preserve instruction-language identity in IFMTBench response joins
identities.screening_reason: The exact patch changes response lookup from md5 alone to the composite (md5, instruction_lang), retains an explicit md5-only compatibility fallback, and computes coverage over matched test-item identities. This is a real evaluator-correction contract: a content-only key can overwrite or attach the wrong language variant and corrupt slice scores even when execution succeeds.
